_provenance: Static general reference maintained separately from diagnostic AI responses. Initial notes were assistant-authored and require manual agricultural expert review; they are not expert-verified.

Apple Scab Leaf.generalInformation: Scab-like spotting can have several causes. Compare both leaf surfaces and seek expert confirmation.

symptoms: No obvious lesions in the observed area
Apple leaf.generalInformation: A healthy-looking apple leaf does not rule out early infection or problems elsewhere on the plant.

Apple rust leaf.generalInformation: Rust-like marks require close inspection; other stresses can produce similar color changes.

Bell_pepper leaf.generalInformation: Observe new and old pepper leaves over time; apparent health in one photo is limited evidence.

Bell_pepper leaf spot.generalInformation: Leaf spot is a broad visual label. A photograph alone cannot confirm the causal organism.

Blueberry leaf.generalInformation: Blueberry coloration varies with season and nutrition. Compare against typical leaves of the same plant.

Cherry leaf.generalInformation: A healthy-looking cherry leaf is a visual observation, not proof that the tree is disease-free.

Corn Gray leaf spot.generalInformation: Gray leaf spot-like lesions can resemble other corn leaf damage. Document the pattern across several leaves.

Corn leaf blight.generalInformation: This dataset uses a broad corn blight label. Confirm the specific cause before considering treatment.

Corn rust leaf.generalInformation: Rust-like symptoms should be checked on both sides of leaves by a qualified local adviser.

Peach leaf.generalInformation: Check the wider plant and new growth as well as the photographed peach leaf.

Potato leaf early blight.generalInformation: Ring-like lesions may resemble early blight, but other damage can look similar in a photo.

Potato leaf late blight.generalInformation: Rapidly expanding damage warrants prompt local expert assessment. A photo does not establish late blight.

Raspberry leaf.generalInformation: Raspberry leaves naturally differ between upper and lower surfaces. Inspect both when documenting health.

Soyabean leaf.generalInformation: The original dataset spells this plant Soyabean. The interface normalizes the plant name to Soybean.

symptoms: Patches may spread over the surface
Squash Powdery mildew leaf.generalInformation: Natural squash markings can resemble mildew. Compare texture and progression before drawing conclusions.

Strawberry leaf.generalInformation: Apparent visual health applies only to the photographed area and time.

Tomato Early blight leaf.generalInformation: Several tomato conditions overlap visually. Record which leaves are affected and how symptoms develop.

Tomato Septoria leaf spot.generalInformation: Small tomato leaf spots need expert examination to distinguish among possible causes.

Tomato leaf.generalInformation: An apparently healthy tomato leaf cannot rule out hidden, early-stage or non-visible problems.

Tomato leaf bacterial spot.generalInformation: The bacterial spot label describes a dataset class; bacterial causation cannot be confirmed from this app.

Tomato leaf late blight.generalInformation: Document changes and seek local assessment if damage progresses quickly.

symptoms: Mottled light and dark green areas
Tomato leaf mosaic virus.generalInformation: Mosaic-like patterns can overlap with nutritional and environmental stress. A viral cause requires confirmation.

symptoms: Possible curling or reduced leaf growth
Tomato leaf yellow virus.generalInformation: This is the original dataset label. Yellowing has many possible causes and is not sufficient evidence of a virus.

symptoms: Yellowish areas on the upper leaf
Tomato mold leaf.generalInformation: Inspect both sides of the leaf. Mold-like appearance needs confirmation and can be affected by photo lighting.

Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf.generalInformation: Tiny pests may not be resolved by a photo. Close inspection with magnification can help an expert assess the cause.

grape leaf.generalInformation: Grape leaves vary with cultivar and age. A single image offers only a limited visual health check.

symptoms: Tan or brown spots with darker margins
Small dark points may be visible
grape leaf black rot.generalInformation: Black rot-like leaf spots can resemble other damage. Inspect the wider vine and seek local guidance.
